newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.03 down at 41.30 to the dollar in the kerb market on Wednesday after the U.S. currency gained against some major currencies on the international markets, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open lower on Thursday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 6, was 40.3300/40.5317 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.30 percent compared to the opening at 2.50 percent.
